question.text: The length of intercept cut by the line <math><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> on the curve <math><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to

solution.text:
The given line passes through the focus 14,0, so it is a focal chord for the given parabola.

Hence, its slope is tan⁡α=-13
∴ the length of the intercept is the same as the length of the focal chord

Hence, the length of the intercept=4acosec2α=4⋅1⋅22=16 units
